missionPremise.ruling: Operator dispatch 2026-08-19 SYSTEMS SEAT BP-01: the useful cut is merge kind, not era. 66 ancestry + 4 empty-diff are zero-loss. 82 squash/cherry hold commit-level reasoning only on the local ref. Lane-level history is not judged 82 times; it is bundled once. Nobody owns LDT history; a bulk operator assertion is a declaration, not an inference. Fail-closed exists to stop the scanner inferring ownership, not to stop a human asserting it.

design.bulkRulePrecedence: Named declarations[] row for (repo, branch) wins. Else first matching bulkRule. Else undeclared. Missing bulk-rule context (no tip date) does not match — fail closed.

namedOverrides.replit-incoming: status unknown — retire with Replit seat, not this prune

deletePath.git: branch -D after deleteEligible true. -d is the ancestry test that undercounted squash; the control's merge detector is the authority.

bundle.thin: ^origin/main so objects already on main are prerequisites, not packed
bundle.verify: fetch one content-cherry ref into a clone that has origin/main; git log --format=%H identical to live ref; origin/main..ref non-empty

adversarial.bulkRuleCouldSweepReplit: Rejected: excludeBranches plus named unknown row. Two independent holds.
adversarial.gitBranchDashDOnUnmerged: -D is used only after HY-01 deleteEligible. A non-eligible branch is never passed to -D.
adversarial.secondMechanismFor152: Could be 'branches git thinks unmerged'. Rejected: 66 are ancestry-merged; the 82 are content-cherry. Split is merge-kind, measured.
